use serde_json::Value;

pub fn solve(input: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    let mut words = input.as_str().split_whitespace().collect();
    words.reverse();
    words.join(" ")
}

// Example usage:
fn main() {
    let input = serde_json::Value::from(" one  two	three ");
    let expected = serde_json::Value::from("three two one");
    let result = solve(input);
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
